name: ReactHuman
summary: Evaluates reactive decision-making by multimodal language models controlling a simulated humanoid under sudden household hazards, including objects whose appearance contradicts their physical properties. All committed plans are physically executed.
numbers: 17 event families, 1,000+ scenes, 7 models; roughly one hazard in three mishandled

why.dex: A pre-trained whole-body controller executes the model's commands.
why.cog: Must trust motion over appearance, under time pressure.
